app.name: Lexsus
app.tagline: Your local bridge between a web AI and your codebase

onboarding.tagline: Your local bridge between a web AI and your codebase.

steps.title: Bind a project
steps.desc: Pick the folder your web AI will work on. Every file it reads or edits is resolved against it — nothing happens outside.

steps.title: Watch every move
steps.desc: Reads, edits and commands stream in as they happen, so you always see exactly what the AI is doing and why.

steps.title: Approve before it acts
steps.desc: Writes and shell commands pause for your call. Allow, deny, or grant for the session — you stay in control.

steps.title: Review and commit
steps.desc: Inspect the diff, switch branches and commit the AI's work without ever leaving the workbench.

steps.title: Continue anywhere
steps.desc: Package your progress into a clean handoff so another AI can pick up the thread without losing context.

steps.title: Remember decisions
steps.desc: Facts, decisions and dead ends are saved across sessions, so nobody re-litigates the same problem twice.

steps.title: Connect your AI
steps.desc: Point your web AI at the local endpoint. It binds loopback only — read-only until you enable writes.
